prompt: Implement stableUnique(_ values: [String]) -> [String], keeping the first occurrence of each exact string, in order.
assertions: precondition(stableUnique(["b","a","b","A"]) == ["b","a","A"]); precondition(stableUnique([]).isEmpty)

prompt: Implement searchTitles(_ titles: [String], query: String) -> [String]. Trim query whitespace, compare case-insensitively, preserve order, and return all titles for an empty query.
assertions: precondition(searchTitles(["Swift","Garden","SWIFT UI"], query: " swift ") == ["Swift","SWIFT UI"]); precondition(searchTitles(["A"], query: "  ") == ["A"])

prompt: Implement page<T>(_ values: [T], offset: Int, limit: Int) -> [T]. Negative offsets clamp to zero; nonpositive limits and out-of-range offsets return empty. Handle Int.max without overflow.
assertions: precondition(page([1,2,3], offset: -1, limit: 2) == [1,2]); precondition(page([1,2], offset: 1, limit: Int.max) == [2]); precondition(page([1], offset: Int.max, limit: 2).isEmpty)

prompt: Implement progress(completed: Int, total: Int) -> Double. Return zero for nonpositive totals; otherwise clamp the ratio to 0...1, with no integer overflow.
assertions: precondition(progress(completed: 3, total: 4) == 0.75); precondition(progress(completed: -1, total: 4) == 0); precondition(progress(completed: Int.max, total: 1) == 1); precondition(progress(completed: 1, total: 0) == 0)

prompt: Implement shortened(_ text: String, maxCharacters: Int) -> String using extended grapheme clusters. Return at most maxCharacters characters, with no ellipsis; nonpositive limits return empty.
assertions: precondition(shortened("👨‍👩‍👧‍👦abc", maxCharacters: 2) == "👨‍👩‍👧‍👦a"); precondition(shortened("abc", maxCharacters: 0).isEmpty); precondition(shortened("éxy", maxCharacters: 1) == "é")

prompt: Implement isSafeComponent(_ value: String) -> Bool for a single local filename component. Reject empty, dot, dot-dot, slashes, backslashes and NUL; accept spaces and Unicode without modifying the value.
assertions: precondition(!isSafeComponent("../a")); precondition(!isSafeComponent("..")); precondition(!isSafeComponent("a\\b")); precondition(!isSafeComponent("a\u{0}b".replacingOccurrences(of: "\u{0}", with: String(UnicodeScalar(0)!)))); precondition(isSafeComponent("旅行 notes"))

prompt: Implement queryURL(base: URL, key: String, value: String) -> URL? that accepts only HTTPS URLs with host and no credentials, preserves existing query items and appends one item without string concatenation.
assertions: let u = queryURL(base: URL(string: "https://example.com/p?x=1")!, key: "q", value: "a&b")!; let q = URLComponents(url:u,resolvingAgainstBaseURL:false)!.queryItems!; precondition(q.count == 2 && q[1].value == "a&b"); precondition(queryURL(base:URL(string:"http://example.com")!,key:"q",value:"x") == nil)

prompt: Implement redacted(_ value: String) -> String: for strings longer than four characters show the last four characters preceded by exactly four asterisks; otherwise return four asterisks. Count graphemes, not bytes.
assertions: precondition(redacted("abcdef") == "****cdef"); precondition(redacted("abc") == "****"); precondition(redacted("") == "****")

prompt: Implement parseCount(_ text: String) -> Int? that trims whitespace and accepts only nonempty ASCII digits representing 0...10000. Reject plus/minus signs, decimals, overflow and Unicode digits.
assertions: precondition(parseCount(" 42 ") == 42); precondition(parseCount("+1") == nil); precondition(parseCount("10001") == nil); precondition(parseCount("١") == nil); precondition(parseCount("000") == 0)

prompt: Implement average(_ values: [Double]) -> Double? returning nil for empty or nonfinite inputs. Avoid overflow when averaging finite values including [Double.greatestFiniteMagnitude, Double.greatestFiniteMagnitude].
assertions: precondition(average([2,4]) == 3); precondition(average([]) == nil); precondition(average([.nan]) == nil); precondition(average([Double.greatestFiniteMagnitude,Double.greatestFiniteMagnitude]) == Double.greatestFiniteMagnitude)

prompt: Define struct Book with let title: String and let pages: Int; implement sortedBooks(_ books: [Book]) -> [Book] sorted by pages ascending then title lexicographically ascending.
assertions: let b = sortedBooks([Book(title:"Z",pages:1),Book(title:"A",pages:2),Book(title:"B",pages:1)]); precondition(b.map(\.title) == ["B","Z","A"])

prompt: Implement toggled<T: Hashable>(_ value: T, in values: Set<T>) -> Set<T>, returning a new set with membership toggled without mutating the input.
assertions: let original:Set<Int> = [1,2]; precondition(toggled(2,in:original) == [1]); precondition(toggled(3,in:original) == [1,2,3]); precondition(original == [1,2])

prompt: Define Codable, Equatable struct Settings with let notifications: Bool. Implement decodeSettings(_ data: Data) throws -> Settings. Invalid or missing fields must throw rather than silently using defaults.
assertions: let s = try decodeSettings(Data("{\"notifications\":true}".utf8)); precondition(s == Settings(notifications:true)); do { _ = try decodeSettings(Data("{}".utf8)); preconditionFailure("missing field silently accepted") } catch {}

prompt: Implement merged(_ defaults: [String: String], overrides: [String: String]) -> [String: String], where overrides win and keys absent from overrides are retained.
assertions: precondition(merged(["a":"1","b":"2"],overrides:["b":"3"]) == ["a":"1","b":"3"]); precondition(merged([:],overrides:[:]).isEmpty)

prompt: Implement incremented(_ value: Int, upperBound: Int) -> Int. Values at or above upperBound return upperBound; smaller values increment by one safely, including Int.max boundaries.
assertions: precondition(incremented(2,upperBound:4) == 3); precondition(incremented(Int.max,upperBound:Int.max) == Int.max); precondition(incremented(8,upperBound:4) == 4)

prompt: Implement normalizedRange(start: Int, end: Int, count: Int) -> Range<Int> that clamps endpoints into 0...max(count,0); if clamped end is below clamped start return an empty range at clamped start.
assertions: precondition(normalizedRange(start:-3,end:8,count:4) == 0..<4); precondition(normalizedRange(start:3,end:1,count:4) == 3..<3); precondition(normalizedRange(start:0,end:4,count:-1).isEmpty)

prompt: Implement bookID(from url: URL) -> UUID? accepting only reading://book/<UUID> URLs, rejecting other schemes, hosts, credentials, additional path components, queries and fragments.
assertions: let id=UUID(); precondition(bookID(from:URL(string:"reading://book/\(id.uuidString)")!) == id); precondition(bookID(from:URL(string:"reading://other/\(id.uuidString)")!) == nil); precondition(bookID(from:URL(string:"reading://book/\(id.uuidString)/extra")!) == nil)

prompt: Implement grouped(_ values: [String]) -> [String: [String]] grouping by the first Character as a String key (empty strings use an empty key), preserving order within each group.
assertions: precondition(grouped(["ab","ac","ba",""]) == ["a":["ab","ac"],"b":["ba"],"":[""]]); precondition(grouped(["👩‍💻a"])["👩‍💻"] == ["👩‍💻a"])

prompt: Implement uniqueIDs(_ values: [UUID?]) -> [UUID], ignoring nil, preserving order and keeping each UUID once.
assertions: let a=UUID(),b=UUID(); precondition(uniqueIDs([nil,a,b,a,nil]) == [a,b]); precondition(uniqueIDs([]).isEmpty)

prompt: Implement percentage(_ value: Double, of total: Double) -> Double? returning nil for nonfinite inputs, total <= 0, or a nonfinite result. Otherwise return value / total * 100, without clamping.
assertions: precondition(percentage(1,of:4) == 25); precondition(percentage(2,of:1) == 200); precondition(percentage(.infinity,of:1) == nil); precondition(percentage(1,of:0) == nil); precondition(percentage(1,of:.leastNonzeroMagnitude) == nil)
